decisions.reason: As a distant niche line with weak later visibility and limited connection to the firm's core LED lighting trajectory, submarine interior lighting is the easiest commitment to abandon by 2022 despite sunk development costs.

The medical examination light used existing capabilities and initially justified persistence, but two years without observed presence weaken public commitment and make this adjacent market easier to exit.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires remain closely tied to the firm's industrial customer base, engineering strengths and multi-model investment, so management is still more likely to persist than withdraw.

Although the designer task light had a visible relaunch and some legacy commitment behind it, its weaker fit with the firm's main professional segments and lack of later visibility now tilt management toward ending it.
The pendant office luminaire is close to the established business and the firm's announced direction in efficient building lighting, so escalation of commitment favors continued support.
The premium pendant luminaire is a recent multi-model line in a core application area, combining high visible commitment and strong strategic fit that make continuation very likely.
